html{height:100%;font-size:24px}
body{height:100%;background-color:#ccccaa}
#page{width:1200px;height:720px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%)}
#layout{width:1200px;height:720px;background-color:#fff}
#left{float:left;width:600px;height:720px}
#right{float:left;width:600px;height:720px}
#box1{float:left;width:240px;height:720px}
#box1a{width:216px;height:624px;margin-left:24px;margin-top:24px}
#logo{width:192px}
#box1b{width:192px;height:24px;margin-left:24px;margin-top:24px}
#box2{float:left;width:360px;height:720px}
#box2a{width:360px;height:720px}
#box3{float:left;width:600px;height:720px}
#box3a{width:552px;height:504px;margin-left:24px;margin-top:24px}
#box3b{width:552px;height:144px;margin-left:24px;margin-top:24px}
#map{width:552px;height:276px;clear:both;background-color:#eee}
.box2image{width:360px;height:720px}
.border{border:1px solid #737560}

h1{font-size:1.2em;line-height:1.1em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555;text-align:center;margin:0;padding:0}
h2{font-size:1em;line-height:1.5em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555;text-align:center;margin:0;padding:0 0 1em 0}
h3{font-size:0.95em;line-height:1.5em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555;text-align:center;margin:0;padding:0 0 0.5em 0}
h4{font-size:1em;line-height:1.5em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555;text-align:left;margin:0;padding:0 0 0.5em 0}
h5{font-size:0.7em;line-height:1.5em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555;text-align:left;margin:0;padding:0 0 0.5em 0;font-style:italic}
p{font-size:.8em;line-height:1.8em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555;text-align:left;margin:0;padding:0 0 1em 0}
ul{font-size:.8em;line-height:2em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555}
ol{font-size:.5em;line-height:2em;font-family:"Open Sans",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:middle;color:#555}

.bold{font-weight:700}
.italic{font-style:italic}
.superscript{font-size:.8em;vertical-align:baseline;position:relative;top:-.4em}
.subscript{font-size:.8em;vertical-align:baseline;position:relative;top:.4em}
.clearboth{clear:both}
.textcentre{text-align:center}
.textleft{text-align:left}
.textright{text-align:right}

#box1 a:link{color:#555;text-decoration:none}
#box1 a:visited{color:#555;text-decoration:none}
#box1 a:hover{color:#777;text-decoration:none}
#box3 a:link{color:#06c;text-decoration:none}
#box3 a:visited{color:#06c;text-decoration:none}
#box3 a:hover{color:#777;text-decoration:none}
#box3b #contact a:link{color:#555;text-decoration:none}
#box3b #contact a:visited{color:#555;text-decoration:none}
#box3b #contact a:hover{color:#777;text-decoration:none}
#box3b #footer a:link{color:#888;text-decoration:none}
#box3b #footer a:visited{color:#888;text-decoration:none}
#box3b #footer a:hover{color:#aaa;text-decoration:none}

#navigation{padding-top:1em}
#box1a li{line-height:1.3em;padding-bottom:0.7em}
#box1b p{font-size:.6em}
#box3b #contact p{font-size:.65em}
#box3b #footer p{font-size:.5em;color:#888}

.rslides {
  position: relative;
  list-style: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0;
  }

.rslides li {
  -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
  position: absolute;
  display: none;
  width: 100%;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  }

.rslides li:first-child {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  float: left;
  }

.rslides img {
  display: block;
  height: auto;
  float: left;
  width: 100%;
  }
